error_catalog.name: factual-error
error_catalog.description: A statement that is simply untrue according to the source. Example: The hero is a doctor (the source says a merchant).

error_catalog.name: contradiction
error_catalog.description: A statement that says the opposite of the source. Example: She accepts the proposal (the source says she refuses).

error_catalog.name: wrong-number
error_catalog.description: A number, year or amount that does not match the source. Example: 1890 instead of 1887.

error_catalog.name: unsupported-claim
error_catalog.description: A statement the source does not support at all. Example: He later moved to Paris (not mentioned).

error_catalog.name: misattribution
error_catalog.description: A true statement given to the wrong person or place. Example: The brother, not the sister, leaves the town.
